title: Primary Logo with Background
slide_intent: Match the logo’s backing to its medium so the same mark remains legible over images and in fabricated signs.
strategic_value: A controlled backing can protect Burger King’s warm identity while allowing signage to remain bright.
demonstration: Two logos on BBQ Brown compare a Mayo Egg White backing with registration for film/photography and a white backing without registration for restaurant signage.
practical_value: Select the backing by medium and seek the stated marketing or legal guidance for registration on signage.

content_islands.name: Medium-specific guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the film, photography and signage explanation in the left column.

content_islands.name: Film and photography logo
content_islands.spec: Place the registered Mayo Egg White-backed logo in the center under its caption.

content_islands.name: Restaurant signage logo
content_islands.spec: Place the white-backed logo to the right under the signage-only caption.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that backing retains legibility over images and white appears brighter in acrylic or plastic signage.
reference_purposes.Expression: The side-by-side specimens reveal the warm image backing and brighter signage backing.
reference_purposes.Application: Film/photography and restaurant signage receive separately labeled versions.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The image-backed version is used only over an image; signage registration requires consultation.

ingredient.name: Primary logo backing
ingredient.role: Separate the logo from complex imagery or support a bright fabricated sign.
ingredient.application: Use Mayo Egg White behind the logo over film or photography; use white for acrylic or plastic restaurant signage.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; consult BKC marketing/legal for signage registration. The illustrated no-registration sign is not universal permission.
